C-SESSION-DURABILITY.IntentSummary: Prove the shipped session durability contract and close its four unproven or stale corners without touching any predecessor decision. (1) Close-after-write becomes proven coverage: a named unit pin proves the per-tab reading-position flushes that ride the batched session write complete before the close command is invoked (flush-inclusive confirmation scope), and a new e2e spec injects a slow, a never-settling and a rejecting mt_prefs_set_many through the existing tauri-shim seams to prove mt_close_window fires only after a settling write, that the two-second bound fires with BLOCK_SESSION_COMMIT_TIMEOUT while the close still completes, and that a rejected write completes the close with BLOCK_SESSION_WRITE_FAILED — the bound's value and the timeout-still-closes trade stay the predecessor C-SESSION-WRITE-ATOMICITY's owner-confirmed decisions, unchanged. (2) recentlyClosed stops deleting on any stat failure: the filePositionStore tri-state stat verdict (true / false = confirmed not-a-file including MT_FS_NOT_FOUND / undefined = cannot tell) is ported through the shared exported helper, so REOPEN_ONE and REOPEN_ALL drop an entry only on a confirmed false; cannot-tell entries keep the entry behind their own localized notice (new recent.recentlyClosed.* keys in all ten locales), the confirmed-missing behavior is byte-identical to today, and the stale vitest pins that reward generic-rejection drops are unfolded onto coded NOT_FOUND rejections. (3) The live session restore reads the four-key profile as ONE request through the new read-batch mirror of the write batch — PrefsState::get_many / mt_prefs_get_many (one mutex acquisition, absent keys as null, read-only: no save, no generation change, no broadcast) registered next to mt_prefs_set_many, the ipcPrefs.getMany facade wrapper (raw invoke, the setMany precedent) — and checks all saved folder and file paths in ONE concurrent stat pass before the first open; the BOOT_SESSION cold-start capture shares the same one-request read; no backend stat-batch command. (4) The per-tab format lookup stops being O(N²): the formats list is indexed into a Map by pathname once (behavior-preserving by the captureSessionFormats pathname dedup) and the MAX_POSITION_FILES cap (200) is enforced on the write path too via the existing capStoreFiles, so the on-disk position store can never silently exceed the bound between reads. (5) The stale cold-start nets are re-aimed at the shipped C-FIX-009 contract: the affordance-audit test.fixme becomes a real passing test on the contract-shape harness (restoreSessionOnLaunch=false, frozen boot offer, frozen-payload restore, no row when the snapshot is empty) and the regression-tests wel-002 entry stops being a stale pending orphan. Profile content schema, the m001 close state machine, the close-prompt dialog, the 400 ms autosave debounce and the restoreSessionOnLaunch behavior are unchanged.
